primary_task: Create, run and analyze eval suites for an M365 Copilot declarative agent via npx @microsoft/m365-copilot-eval runevals.

requirements.name: node>=24.12.0
requirements.check: node --version; npm view node@24 version; curl https://nodejs.org/

requirements.name: TENANT_ID
requirements.evidence: TENANT_ID, Azure OpenAI in Foundry Models endpoint/key

requirements.name: Azure OpenAI endpoint/key
requirements.evidence: Azure OpenAI in Foundry Models endpoint/key

requirements.name: Microsoft 365 Copilot tenant (licensed, deployed agent, admin consent)
requirements.evidence: Microsoft 365 Copilot license and a deployed M365 Copilot agent; Tenant admin consent
requirements.check: no M365 credential/CLI auth; env grep m365/tenant

requirements.name: Microsoft 365 / Azure endpoints
requirements.evidence: runs evals against deployed agent and Azure OpenAI
requirements.check: curl https://substrate.office.com/ https://graph.microsoft.com/ https://management.azure.com/ https://openai.azure.com/ https://login.microsoftonline.com/

blocking: account:Microsoft 365 Copilot tenant (licensed, deployed agent, admin consent)
notes: Dataset authoring alone is possible, but running evals (core) needs tenant, Azure OpenAI creds and Microsoft egress, none available. Exact Microsoft endpoints the CLI uses are inferred.
